fact: 萨尼科家的老仆告诉薇德拉：道利不见了，宅子前门没关严，山下克兰尼尔镇的大路看得见
anchor: But what I did find was the front door of the house not quite closed

fact: 梅尔娜指认塔赫图拉赫（小丘之屋）曾是弗兰恩家的宅子，如今住着第一领主的里夫哈根
anchor: That’s Tach Tulach—House on the Little Hill—and it used to belong to Flann’s family

fact: 佩金是商队里那位富商之妻、曾在旅途中照顾薇德拉，此刻在圣米尔恰神庙朝圣
anchor: not caring whether it was appropriate to embrace a rich merchant’s wife that way

fact: 佩金说她会在此待到圣费德尔玛节，之后返回赫尼斯阿达赫
anchor: I will be here until Holy Fedelma’s Day, if you need me

fact: 佩金说有人看见一个男孩在神庙屋顶上爬，薇德拉立刻断定是道利
anchor: there was a boy climbing on the temple roof

anchor: a mass of sticks and straw the size of a wide-brimmed hat, with two tan and brown-spotted eggs in it

anchor: if they haven’t hatched this late in the season, they’re most likely dead

anchor: We can’t, Mistress Pegeen. It’s so kind of you, but Flann and the others need us
